questions.text: In trajectory1ad1af4b at state5 immediately after the attempted Description fill, what validation outcome is explicitly shown? Answer accepted or rejected.
In trajectory1ad1af4b at state5, is the Description textbox populated or empty according to the observed field, not the requested fill action? Answer populated or empty.
In trajectory1ad1af4b at state6 after the next Sidebar fill, what text is visible in the Description textbox? Give the field text at state6, not state5.
In trajectory0ab99e0c at state6 after select_option was attempted, what value is actually selected in the Type combobox? Give the observed value, not the requested action value.
In trajectory0ab99e0c at state5 BEFORE select_option is attempted, what value is in the Type combobox? Give only the value without placeholder punctuation.
In trajectory0ab99e0c at state7 after Add AND Condition is clicked, what Type value is actually shown? Use state7, not state6.
